code:
import requests, numpy as np, re
def fasta_seq(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",
                   headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"},timeout=60)
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:])

accs = {
 "target_A0A2H4GSI3":"A0A2H4GSI3",
 "Natt_UGT85A2_3_paralog":"A0A2I2MND5",
 "CrUGT6_UGT85A23_iridoid1OGT":"F8WLS6",
 "CrUGT8_UGT709C2_7DLGT(EC2.4.1.323)":"U3U992",
 "Sb_UGT85B1_dhurrin":"Q9SBL1",
 "At_UGT85A1":"Q9SK82",
 "At_UGT72B1_Nglucosyl":"Q9M156",
 "At_UGT84A1":"Q5XF20",
}
seqs={n:fasta_seq(a) for n,a in accs.items()}

def nw_identity(a,b,match=1,mismatch=-1,gap=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b)
    H=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int32)
    H[:,0]=np.arange(n+1)*gap; H[0,:]=np.arange(m+1)*gap
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]; prev=H[i-1]; row=H[i]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=prev[j-1]+(match if ai==b[j-1] else mismatch)
            v=d
            if prev[j]+gap>v: v=prev[j]+gap
            if row[j-1]+gap>v: v=row[j-1]+gap
            row[j]=v
    i,j=n,m; ident=alen=0
    while i>0 and j>0:
        cur=H[i,j]
        if cur==H[i-1,j-1]+(match if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else mismatch):
            ident+= a[i-1]==b[j-1]; alen+=1; i-=1; j-=1
        elif cur==H[i-1,j]+gap: i-=1; alen+=1
        else: j-=1; alen+=1
    return 100.0*ident/alen

names=list(seqs)
M=np.zeros((len(names),len(names)))
for i,a in enumerate(names):
    for j,b in enumerate(names):
        if j<i: M[i,j]=M[j,i]; continue
        M[i,j]=100.0 if a==b else nw_identity(seqs[a],seqs[b])
print("%IDENTITY MATRIX")
print("".ljust(36)+"".join(f"{k[:9]:>10}" for k in names))
for i,a in enumerate(names):
    print(f"{a[:36]:36s}"+"".join(f"{M[i,j]:10.1f}" for j in range(len(names))))

print("\nTarget closest relatives (sorted):")
ti=names.index("target_A0A2H4GSI3")
order=sorted([(M[ti,j],names[j]) for j in range(len(names)) if j!=ti], reverse=True)
for v,n in order: print(f"  {v:5.1f}%  {n}")

# PSPG box anchored on HCGWNS
print("\nPSPG box (30 aa ending at HCGWNS-type motif):")
for n,s in seqs.items():
    m=re.search(r'.{20}HCG[WF]NS', s)
    print(f"{n:36s} {m.group(0) if m else 'NA'}")

# NJ tree from distance = 100-identity
try:
    from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, dendrogram
    from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
    D=100-M; np.fill_diagonal(D,0)
    Z=linkage(squareform(D,checks=False),method='average')
    import matplotlib; matplotlib.use('Agg'); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    plt.figure(figsize=(9,4))
    dendrogram(Z,labels=names,leaf_rotation=90)
    plt.title("UGT UPGMA tree (1 - %identity)  —  target vs characterized UGTs")
    plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("ugt_tree.png",dpi=130)
    print("\nsaved ugt_tree.png")
except Exception as e:
    print("tree err",e)
